facts.fact: Fergus 转过身朝她笑、一脸汗；他手里那台工业订书机的"金属嘴"又红又湿
facts.anchor: Fergus turned back to me, grinning and sweating.

facts.fact: 他把她的沉默读成"你想教训我"，一边反问一边朝她点头
facts.anchor: “You wanted to teach me a lesson, didn’t you?” he said.

facts.fact: 她还没来得及回答，他就把订书机打进了自己的眼睛
facts.anchor: Before I could answer, he fired the stapler into his eye.

facts.fact: 她说自己并没有觉得好一点——这一套从不让她好过
facts.anchor: “I don’t feel better,” I said. “It doesn’t make me feel better! It never does.

facts.fact: 她意识到这就是"考验"，是她要过的第一关
facts.anchor: And then I realised. This was it. I was being tested.

facts.fact: Callie-Ann 早先教过她：她考验你的时候，别砍，打个结
facts.anchor: “When she tests you,” Callie-Ann had said, “make a knot instead.”

facts.fact: 她当面对他说：这一切从来跟她无关，他根本看不见她
facts.anchor: “It was never about me. None of this is. You couldn’t even see me.”

facts.fact: 她撞开门冲出去，跌在 1a 的楼梯平台上
facts.anchor: And fell onto the landing of 1a.
